whyItMatters: Files gain setuid (chmod 4755 helper), running every caller with the owner's privileges.
actions: Replace setuid with capabilities or a privileged helper service.
If setuid must stay, shrink the binary and audit its inputs.
Re-run the scan and confirm no unjustified setuid remains.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified setuid, and find audits no unexpected setuid files.
